subject: Insurance
title: Wildfire Risk and Retreat
description: A tiny lesson with a big payoff: Wildfire Risk and Retreat.

hook.text: In 2023, seven insurers stopped writing home policies in California.

buildup.text: The Camp Fire in 2018 caused $16.5 billion in insured losses—the costliest wildfire in history.

discovery.text: When private insurers leave, state-backed plans of last resort take over.

twist.text: State plans charge less than the risk warrants, creating hidden taxpayer exposure.

climax.text: Insurer retreat forces a choice: subsidize risk with public money, or stop building where nature will keep burning.

punchline.text: Seven insurers left California. The state now backstops wildfire risk for all.

quiz.question: What happens when private insurers leave a high-risk area?
options: State-backed plans of last resort take over, creating taxpayer exposure
